name: PRs, Actions and Releases Status
description: Shows the pull requests, GitHub Actions checks and release state of the project in your focused Orca workspace. It is for developers who ship from GitHub. Read the checks of any branch or added repository, re-run failed checks, and ask an agent to take over a release.

cover.alt: The PRs tab lists five worktrees with a coloured dot and a badge: closed, merged, ready, running and failed.

screenshots.alt: The PRs tab lists each worktree that has a pull request, with a coloured state badge and a button to open the pull request.
